rows.pair: turbine blade tip to CMC shroud (radial)
rows.cold_basis: design value of tools/g6/humphrey.py (G_TT); the kernel clearance certificate of the built design replaces it

rotor.basis: COMPUTED: MIL-HDBK-5J Waspaloy mean expansion (Figure 6.3.8.0) at the stated temperatures; rotating annular disc (Timoshenko) r 10-62.3 mm, 30 mm thick, 41 blades as rim pull; blade self-stretch

stator.basis: COMPUTED: measured N24A expansion 6.0e-6/K (NASA TM-2009-215806, Table IV) at the turbine exit gas temperature, the coldest gas washing the shroud (closes the gap most)

rotor.basis: COMPUTED: MIL-HDBK-5J Ti-6Al-4V mean expansion (Figure 5.4.1.0); solid rotating disc hoop growth (1-nu)/4 rho w^2 r^2 / E

stator.basis: ISA intake air, the coldest state of the shroud (closes the gap most)

rows.pair: impeller exducer tip at the shroud contour (contour normal)

rotor.basis: COMPUTED: MIL-HDBK-5J Ti-6Al-4V mean expansion (Figure 5.4.1.0); solid rotating disc hoop growth (1-nu)/4 rho w^2 r^2 / E

stator.basis: ISA intake air, the coldest state of the shroud (closes the gap most)

refusals.target: cold turbine tip clearance <= 0.15 mm that stays positive at temperature (brief section 4.4)
refusals.computed: cold 0.15 mm closes 0.520 mm at 43842 r/min: running -0.370 mm (rub); a positive running gap needs 0.57 mm cold
refusals.physics: the Waspaloy rotor grows 0.812 mm thermally and 0.074 mm by spin, while the monolithic SiC/SiC shroud (6.0e-6/K) grows only 0.366 mm; the brief fixes the shroud as part of the CMC monolith, so no carrier ring can match the rotor
